contact.name: Oliver Hounslow
contact.evidence_quote: “It was a brilliant day of football in the sunshine, bringing together clients, consultants and colleagues in support of a great cause, creating new connections, and strengthening existing relationships,” SAYS OLIVER HOUNSLOW, STRUCTURE TONE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER WHO ORGANISED THE EVENT. “We’ve worked with Band of Builders closely over the past few years, so it was great to give something back to a charity that provides life-changing support to people across our industry.”

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: As football fever swept across the globe this summer, Structure Tone UK channeled the excitement into something far more meaningful than a final score. The company’s annual charity football tournament brought together colleagues, clients, and industry partners in support of Band of Builders (BoB), reinforcing a shared commitment to supporting construction workers facing some of life’s toughest challenges.

And while competition remained high throughout the tournament, with exigere lifting the Champions Cup and Structure Tone UK securing the Plate Trophy, the event’s greatest achievement was the awareness and support generated for a cause that continues to make a tangible difference across the industry.

Avery shares an example from a corporate campus project in Arkansas, where installation scraps from carpet tile are being collected, palletized, and returned for recycling. She explains how collaboration among Structure Tone Southwest, Layton, Shaw, and the flooring subcontractor helped make the program possible.
